subject: MedSpan Hosted API — request for 22% strategic volume concession
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: MedSpan Hosted API — request for 22% strategic volume concession

Ben / Stephanie / Marcus —

Quick summary: MedSpan (Olivia Barnes) is pushing for a 22% discount on Hosted API list pricing for a 12-month committed engagement. They’re proposing a minimum committed spend of $960,000 ARR (projected 24M tokens/month ramping to 30M), with a pilot/signing window this week. They are evaluating two competing vendors and have asked us to match a competitor’s price to win the account.

Why this matters: MedSpan is a strategic prospect for us in enterprise health (multi-region plans including US & EU), expected to expand beyond NLU into embeddings and reranking if we win. The ACV is meaningful (first year commit ~ $960k, potential multi-year expansion).

Ask: This exceeds our standard 20% threshold for delegated discounts. Can we get an exec exception to approve a 22% hosted-usage concession scoped to a 12-month committed SOW with the following guardrails:
- Prepay for first 6 months or standard credit terms with automatic invoicing on signature
- Minimum monthly usage floor equal to 80% of forecast or revert clause
- Onboarding credit capped at $20k (one-time)

Attachments: MedSpan_SOW_v3.pdf (draft SOW), MedSpan_forecast.xlsx (usage/financials).

They need a yes/no quickly — Olivia said they can sign by Friday if we can commit to the rate and standard SLA.

Recommended next step: Stephanie / deal desk to review pricing guardrails and propose final conditional language; Marcus / revenue to sign off on the concession if terms look acceptable.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MedSpan Hosted API — request for 22% strategic volume concession

Thanks for the context, Kim — and for the docs.

Deal desk notes:
- Any concession beyond 20% requires senior approval per pricing policy.
- Exposure: if usage falls materially short we take a margin hit. Recommend we require prepay for at least the first 6 months or a signed ACH/NET-30 guarantee with finance counterparty review.

Proposed conditional approval language (for Marcus):
1) 22% off list for 12 months provided MedSpan commits to a minimum annualized spend of $960k.
2) Prepayment for months 1–6 invoiced upon signature; remainder invoiced quarterly.
3) Failure to hit 80% of monthly committed usage for two consecutive months triggers rate reversion to standard published rates and an overage true-up.
4) Onboarding credit capped at $20k (one-time) to be applied to first invoice.
5) Legal to confirm there are no non-standard data residency or indemnity asks in the attached SOW.

I’ve started a DocuSign envelope (link below) to keep timeline tight — legal redlines needed before we send to procurement.

DocuSign (staged): https://docusign.example.com/MS-7834
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/56321/deal/HS-56321

If Marcus can confirm we’re good with the above conditions I’ll prepare final commercial language and route to Legal + Finance.

—Stephanie
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MedSpan Hosted API — request for 22% strategic volume concession

Appreciate the quick thread. I am comfortable approving a one-time concession up to 22% with the following mandatory conditions in place (no exceptions):

1) Term: 12-month committed term as documented in the attached SOW (MedSpan_SOW_v3.pdf).
2) Financials: Minimum annualized spend $960,000 committed. Invoice and payment terms: prepay for months 1–6 upon contract signature; months 7–12 invoiced quarterly. Finance to confirm invoicing schedule before sending to procurement.
3) Usage floor: If MedSpan fails to reach 80% of the committed monthly usage for two consecutive months, Redwood reserves the right to revert to published list rates and invoice a usage true-up.
4) Onboarding: One-time onboarding credit capped at $20,000 applied to first invoice only.
5) Legal: No non-standard indemnity or data residency terms to be accepted without Legal sign-off.

Given the strategic nature (multi-product expansion potential) and the size of the commitment, this concession is acceptable with those guardrails. Stephanie — please capture this approval in the pricing approval form and loop Legal + Finance for the prepay and contract language.

Kimberly — you have my sign-off to proceed to Docs and procurement once Legal confirms there are no problematic redlines. Keep me posted if they request additional concessions.

Marcus Lin
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround on the forecast. Good news: Redwood can approve a 22% concession on Hosted API list pricing for the 12-month engagement subject to the conditions Marcus authorized below. I’ve summarized the commercial terms and next steps here to keep timelines clear.

Approved commercial terms (summary):
- Discount: 22% off list for Hosted API usage for 12 months
- Committed minimum: $960,000 annualized (detailed in attached forecast)
- Payment: Prepay for months 1–6 due upon signature; months 7–12 invoiced quarterly
- Usage floor: 80% of committed monthly usage; two consecutive months below floor triggers reversion and true-up
- Onboarding credit: One-time, up to $20,000 applied to first invoice
- Legal: Standard Redwood T&Cs; Legal to review the attached SOW for any non-standard clauses

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the draft SOW (MedSpan_SOW_v3.pdf) and the forecast. Please review and confirm no changes by EOD Thursday so Legal can finish a quick review.
2) I will issue the DocuSign envelope (link below) with the SOW and the commercial summary once Legal confirms the language. Please note that prepay invoice will be raised on signature per the terms above.

DocuSign (staged): https://docusign.example.com/MS-7834

If you’d like to talk live before signing, I’m available this afternoon. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the staged envelope and finance will issue the prepay invoice once the contract is signed.

Thanks — excited to get MedSpan onboarded.

Best,
Kimberly Park
